entities.name: Network-requested PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: A procedure initiated by the network to modify a PDU session, re-negotiate header compression configuration, convey port management information, trigger EAS rediscovery, provide updated DNS server addresses, update ECS configuration, remove UE from MBS multicast sessions, update ATSSS parameters, update MBS service area, or inform about service-level AA or C2 authorization results.

entities.name: PDU session
entities.description: Represents a packet data unit session that can be modified by the network.

entities.name: Header compression configuration
entities.description: Configuration parameters for header compression associated with a PDU session.

entities.name: Port management information container
entities.description: A container conveying port management information.

entities.name: EAS rediscovery trigger
entities.description: A trigger for edge application server rediscovery.

entities.name: DNS server address(es)
entities.description: Updated DNS server addresses provided due to newly selected local DNS server or EASDF.

entities.name: ECS configuration information
entities.description: Updated enhanced coverage support configuration information.

entities.name: MBS multicast session
entities.description: Multicast broadcast service multicast session associated with a PDU session.

entities.name: ATSSS parameters
entities.description: Access traffic steering, switching and splitting parameters, such as ATSSS rules.

entities.name: MBS service area
entities.description: Service area for multicast broadcast service sessions.

entities.name: Service-level AA procedure result
entities.description: Result of service-level authentication and authorization procedure.

entities.name: C2 authorization result for UAS services
entities.description: Result of command and control authorization for unmanned aircraft system services.

relations.description: The procedure modifies the PDU session.
The procedure re-negotiates header compression configuration.
The procedure conveys port management information container.
The procedure provides updated DNS server addresses.
The procedure provides updated ECS configuration information.
The procedure removes UE from MBS multicast sessions.
The procedure updates MBS service area.
The procedure informs about service-level AA procedure result.
The procedure informs about C2 authorization result for UAS services.
